# HisoAir

> > HisoAir is a 20+ year OEM/ODM expert in indoor air quality solutions, manufacturing air purifiers, humidifiers, and air quality monitors with advanced filtration and smart IoT integration.

HisoAir specializes in custom manufacturing of indoor air quality devices across Vietnam and Thailand, serving both residential and commercial markets. The company offers comprehensive product lines featuring HEPA H13 filtration, advanced humidification technologies, and IoT-enabled air quality monitoring solutions.

## Key Topics

- OEM/ODM Manufacturing
- HEPA H13 Filtration
- CADR Performance
- PM2.5 Monitoring
- Decibel Cancellation™ Technology
- Smart IoT Integration
- Indoor Air Quality
- SteamPure Technology
- Energy Recovery Systems
- LoRaWAN Connectivity
- Commercial Air Purification
- Residential Solutions
- CE/FCC Certified
- Pet Dander Removal
- Ultrasonic Humidification

## Air Purifier Product Lines

- [Air Purifiers - HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/air-purifiers): HisoAir air purifier product line with CADR performance and certifications
- [Ceiling Air Purifiers - HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/ceiling-air-purifiers): Ceiling-mounted air purifiers (HA800, HA1002, HA2000) with Tuya integration
- [Wall Mounted Air Purifiers | CE/FCC Certified | HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/wall-mounted-air-purifiers): Wall-mounted air purifiers with HEPA H13 filtration and Decibel Cancellation
- [Desktop Air Purifiers - HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/desktop-air-purifiers): Desktop air purifiers with Sleep-Quiet and HEPA H13 filtration technology
- [High Performance Air Purifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/high-performance-air-purifier): High-performance air purifiers (HA600, HA1300) for large commercial spaces
- [Residential Air Purifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/residential-air-purifier): Residential air purifiers (HA200, HA400, HA180, HA380) for home use
- [Commercial Air Purifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/commercial-air-purifier): Commercial air purifiers (HA-1300, HA1000) with H13 HEPA multi-stage filters
- [Pet Air Purifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/pet-air-purifier): Pet air purifiers (HA-D3002, HA65, HA360) for pet dander removal

## Humidifier Solutions

- [Custom Humidifier Manufacturer in Vietnam & Thailand - Hisoair](https://hisoair.com/humidifier-manufacturer): HisoAir custom humidifier manufacturing in Vietnam and Thailand with OEM/ODM
- [Stainless Steel Humidifiers - HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/stainless-steel-humidifiers): Stainless steel humidifiers with SteamPure technology and medical-grade sanitization
- [Ultrasonic Humidifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/ultrasonic-humidifier): Ultrasonic humidifiers (HM2206, HM-D230) with cool and warm mist options
- [Evaporative Humidifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/evaporative-humidifier): Evaporative humidifiers with SteamPure boil technology (HM300, HM800)
- [Humidifier with Air Purifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/humidifier-with-air-purifier): 3-in-1 humidifier-air purifier combos (HA-M182D, HA-M1000D) with smart sensing
- [Large Tank Humidifier – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/large-tank-humidifier): Large tank humidifiers (HM-D229, HM-D239) with anti-bacterial technology
- [Humidifier with Diffuser – HisoAir](https://hisoair.com/product-cat/humidifier-with-diffuser): Humidifiers with diffuser (HM-D0328, HM-D229) for cool/warm mist home use
